```{r}
library(openxlsx)
```

- **Purpose:** Explore summary of the results from the SWAP pipeline. 
  - Making sure there aren't unsusual missing values
  - Making sure tasks that should fail did
  - Looking at unviable tasks (failed during optimization)

- **Input:** summary df
- **Ouput:** none

```{r}
df_summary <- read.csv("data/SWAP_output/summary.csv")
```

I like having tasks as 'task_xx'
```{r}
df_summary <- df_summary %>%
  mutate(Task = as.factor(paste0('task_', Task)))
```


```{r}
tasklist <- read.xlsx('data/SWAP_input/tasklist_test_gtex.xlsx')

tasklist_names <- tasklist %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c('ID', 'DESCRIPTION', 'SHOULD.FAIL')) %>%
  mutate(ID = paste('task', ID, sep = '_'))
```

# Missingness
```{r}
# number of na per column
colSums(is.na(df_summary))

n_distinct(df_summary$Task) == n_distinct(tasklist_names$ID) # results for 6 tasks, same number as in the tasklist
n_distinct(df_summary$Sample) # 20 samples
```

Tasks that should fail
```{r}
tasklist_names[tasklist_names$SHOULD.FAIL == 1, ] # in this tasklist none should fail

# are the tasks that should fail in the summary (should not be)
df_summary %>%
  filter(Task %in% tasklist_names[tasklist_names$SHOULD.FAIL == 1, ]$ID) # none = good
```

```{r}
df_summary %>%
  filter(Solution_is_feasible == FALSE) # empty so all tasks were feasible
```
